name: RoleHint
productStatus: working prototype; hiring-outcome uplift and product-market fit not independently validated
description: Career decision prototype: screen jobs for explicit eligibility constraints, compare requirements against real experience, and identify what to verify before applying.
audience: professionals managing an urgent or targeted job search
userProblems: difficulty seeing which job-search effort works

frequencyBasedWorkflows.name: Opportunity agent demo
frequencyBasedWorkflows.purpose: Edit profile/preferences and explore simulated search, prioritization, eligibility, next actions

frequencyBasedWorkflows.name: Check an actual job description
frequencyBasedWorkflows.purpose: Paste vacancy text for local rules-based checks and copy questions

capabilities: hard eligibility checks before semantic fit
explicit verified, review and gap evidence states
notCapabilities: proven uplift or validated product-market fit
privacyAndControl: The public demo runs without a server, cookie persistence or external requests, beyond static assets; pasted job text and notes stay in the current browser session. The connected backend is a separate environment.
demoData: The agent demo uses fictional employer/job data. The independent text checker accepts pasted real descriptions but processes them locally without fetching or verifying external sources.
demoDescription: Two browser demos: an editable fictional opportunity-agent simulation (role/profile, constraints, shortlist, decision details) and a separate local text-only job-description checker (work mode, region, salary, requirement excerpts and copyable questions). Neither verifies real vacancies or submits applications.
